events.headline: NYSE owner ICE teams up with Trade.xyz to bring Hyperliquid trading to the US
events.eventClass: counterparty infrastructure (ICE equity stake in Trade.xyz; US regulated Hyperliquid-based perps venue)
events.relevance: ICE takes an undisclosed equity stake in Trade.xyz for a CFTC-regulated US perps venue on Hyperliquid infrastructure; subject to CFTC approval, no launch date, no stated HYPE token role
events.sourceName: crypto.news (cites Trade.xyz X post; also Coinpedia, Altcoin Buzz, PANews)

events.headline: Bitso launches Bóvedas, bringing Gauntlet-curated Morpho vaults on Base to its app (USDC and peso-pegged MXNB)
events.eventClass: counterparty integration (Bitso Bóvedas on Morpho vaults)
events.relevance: Major LatAm exchange routes USDC/MXNB deposits into Morpho vaults, a new retail distribution channel; advertised up to 10% MXNB / 5% USDC, variable, no deposit insurance; no TVL, user or country figures disclosed
events.sourceName: The Defiant (Bitso support pages confirm Morpho-powered Vaults)

events.headline: Morpho opens Robinhood Stock Tokens to stablecoin borrowing: NVDA, SPCX and SPY collateral markets live on Robinhood Chain
events.eventClass: counterparty integration (Robinhood Stock Tokens as collateral on Morpho)
events.relevance: New Morpho lending markets (USDG loan asset) on Robinhood Chain that any app can integrate, extending the Robinhood relationship. Non-US persons only; no TVL disclosed; no MORPHO token terms

events.headline: Shinhan Card, SBI VC Trade and SBI XDC Network APAC to explore yen stablecoin payments between Japan and South Korea
events.eventClass: counterparty partnership (SBI XDC Network APAC + SBI VC Trade + Shinhan Card MoU, yen stablecoin payments)
events.relevance: SBI Holdings-announced MoU puts XDC Network infrastructure in a Japan-Korea card/stablecoin payments pilot; exploratory only, no stablecoin named, no timeline, no XDC token terms

events.headline: Meritz Securities and the Optimism Foundation sign MoU to explore tokenized financial assets on OP Stack
events.relevance: Korean broker Meritz will study issuing, settling and distributing tokenized assets on OP Stack / OP Mainnet; exploratory only, no launch dates, no OP token terms
events.sourceName: Optimism (official blog; also Seoul Economic Daily)

events.headline: Polkadot warns Fearless Wallet users to move funds after private-key leak
events.eventClass: key compromise (Fearless Wallet extension private-key leak)
events.relevance: Third-party wallet extension (v3.0.1-3.0.5) leaked account keys; ~17,286 DOT stolen across 8 reported victims; not a chain compromise, but a wallet-security/sentiment hit
events.sourceName: The Defiant (also Crypto Briefing; Polkadot notice not fetched)

events.headline: 21Shares launches physically backed Venice Token ETP (VENC) on SIX Swiss Exchange
events.eventClass: ETP launch (21Shares Venice Token ETP VENC, SIX Swiss Exchange)
events.relevance: First regulated-wrapper access to VVV (physically backed, 2.50% fee) with Anchorage/BitGo custody; initial size small (~$1.3M NAV), so near-term demand effect may be limited

events.headline: Injective partners with BDACS to bring Korean won stablecoin to RWA ecosystem
events.eventClass: counterparty partnership (BDACS KRW1 won stablecoin, MoU)
events.relevance: MoU makes BDACS's KRW1 the exclusive won settlement asset for RWA/tokenization on Injective; no launch date, minting limited to approved institutions and subject to regulatory approval
